faq.question: What is the minimum order for free home delivery?
faq.answer: Minimum order for free home delivery is ₹499 within 2 km. For orders below ₹499, delivery charge is ₹30.

faq.question: How quickly do you deliver?
faq.answer: We deliver to your doorstep within 30 to 45 minutes of order confirmation.

faq.question: Can I just send a handwritten list photo or type my list?
faq.answer: Yes! You can type your grocery list directly here or send a photo of your paper list. We will pack it and confirm the bill.

faq.question: Do you accept UPI or Cash on Delivery?
faq.answer: Both! You can pay via UPI (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm) upon delivery or pay in cash.
